title: Médico(a) Dermatologista
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Médico(a) Dermatologista para integrar o nosso time, atuando com excelência, ética e foco na segurança e bem-estar dos pacientes.


Unidades: Rio de Janeiro | São Paulo | Porto Alegre


Principais atividades:

  • Realizar consultas dermatológicas focadas na saúde da pele, cabelo e unhas, identificando patologias e condições estéticas.
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças dermatológicas (acne, melasma, rosácea, dermatites, etc.).
  • Avaliar e indicar os procedimentos estéticos mais adequados para cada paciente, considerando suas expectativas e características individuais.
  • Executar procedimentos dermatológicos estéticos como: Aplicação de toxina botulínica e preenchedores. Lasers (depilação, remoção de manchas, rejuvenescimento). Peelings químicos e físicos. Microagulhamento. Bioestimuladores de colágeno. Tratamentos para flacidez e gordura localizada (conforme especialização e equipamentos da clínica).
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes pós-procedimentos, garantindo a segurança e os resultados esperados.
  • Prescrever medicamentos e dermocosméticos, orientando sobre o uso adequado.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as últimas tendências, tecnologias e pesquisas na área da dermatologia clínica e estética.
  • Colaborar com a equipe multidisciplinar da clínica (esteticistas, fisioterapeutas, enfermeiros) para um plano de tratamento integrado.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões da equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços.
  • Garantir a ética e a biossegurança em todos os procedimentos e interações com os pacientes.


Requisitos:

  • Formação completa em Medicina, com residência médica em Dermatologia reconhecida pelo MEC e pela SBD (Sociedade Brasileira de Dermatologia).
  • Registro ativo no CRM (Conselho Regional de Medicina) e RQE (Registro de Qualificação de Especialista) em Dermatologia.
  • Experiência comprovada em procedimentos dermatológicos estéticos e tratamentos clínicos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em anatomia facial e corporal.


Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou cursos complementares em Dermatologia Estética ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com tecnologias específicas utilizadas na clínica (ex: ultrassom microfocado, radiofrequência etc.).
  • Portfólio de casos de sucesso.

title: Microsoft 365 Tenant to Tenant Migration Engineer
description:

FuseIT Global is a Miami-based IT consulting and staffing company, delivering exceptional services to clients across the globe. Specializing in providing distributed global talent, FuseIT Global addresses diverse IT requirements with tailored solutions. The company's commitment to quality and innovation drives its success in collaborating with businesses of all sizes. FuseIT Global's expertise lies in creating impactful technology strategies to boost clients' business outcomes.

This is a remote position as a Microsoft 365 Tenant to Tenant Migration Engineer. ﻿·      Availability aligned to ET ± 1 hour

title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Cloud Engineer
description:

  • AWS DevOps Engineer Professional

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description

Join codevista as an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript in a fully remote role. Build and maintain web applications using modern JavaScript technologies like React and Node.js. Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere in Brazil, with collaborative tools and a supportive team environment tailored for beginners eager to grow their skills.

As an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript at codevista, you'll dive into the exciting world of web development while working remotely from anywhere in Brazil. This role is perfect for recent graduates or those with basic programming experience who are passionate about JavaScript and ready to contribute to real-world projects.

Your primary responsibilities will include developing user-facing features using frontend frameworks like React or Vue.js, integrating with backend services built on Node.js and Express, and working with databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL. You'll collaborate on building scalable web applications, fixing bugs, and optimizing performance for our clients' needs. Since this is an entry-level position, expect hands-on guidance from senior developers to help you learn best practices in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Remote work is at the core of our setup at codevista. You'll use tools like Slack for daily communication, Zoom for team meetings and stand-ups, and Jira or Trello for task tracking. We foster a collaborative culture through virtual pair programming sessions and weekly knowledge-sharing calls, ensuring you're never isolated despite the distance. Time zones are considered, with core hours aligned to São Paulo time for seamless teamwork.

Technologies you'll work with include HTML5, CSS3 (with preprocessors like Sass), JavaScript (ES6+), and RESTful APIs. On the backend, you'll handle authentication, data validation, and deployment using platforms like Heroku or AWS basics. For an entry-level role, we emphasize learning over perfection—expect mentorship to build your foundational skills in full-stack development.

This position offers a supportive environment to grow your career. You'll participate in code reviews to understand clean code principles and contribute to open-source inspired projects internally. Remote flexibility means you can balance work with personal life, while our team ensures regular feedback to accelerate your professional development. Join us to turn your JavaScript passion into a rewarding remote career at codevista.

Requirements

  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (e.g., React) and backend runtime (e.g., Node.js)
  • Understanding of REST APIs and basic database concepts
  • Strong self-motivation and time management skills for independent remote work
  • Excellent communication abilities for virtual team collaboration
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).
  • Garantir clareza de premissas e limites das soluções (dados, regras e critérios), com documentação e governança para adoção e manutenção.
  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Norte
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Norte



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:

Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Valores

Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.



Engenheiro de dados (Inglês fluente)


Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior com inglês fluente qualificado com uma base sólida em desenvolvimento baseado em SQL. Essa função se concentrará na criação e manutenção de pipelines de dados usando o PySpark, com SQL como a linguagem de codificação principal. O candidato também terá uma boa compreensão das estruturas de modelagem de dados (como modelagem dimensional Kimball) e experiência no suporte a datawarehouses e data marts.


Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em lote usando o PySpark (focado em SQL)

Escreva e otimize consultas SQL complexas para dar suporte à lógica de negócios e às necessidades de relatórios

Entenda os requisitos de forma autônoma e traduza para código

Transforme e integre dados de diversas fontes em tabelas Iceberg e Snowflake

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de data marts e conjuntos de dados selecionados para consumo comercial

Colabore com analistas de negócios para entender as necessidades de dados

Monitore e gerencie trabalhos de dados em execução no AWS EMR orquestrados pelo Airflow, aproveitando o S3, o Glue e outros serviços da AWS

Garanta a qualidade, a consistência e o desempenho dos dados em todo o pipeline




Qualificações preferenciais

Experiência na criação e gerenciamento de data marts

Exposição ao Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração

Familiaridade com ferramentas de infraestrutura como código, como o Terraform

Compreensão dos padrões ODS (Operational Data Store) e arquitetura de data lake

Experiência com Bitbucket (ou qualquer ferramenta git semelhante)

Experiência/compreensão de Jenkins



Habilidades Comportamentais e Competências:

Fluência em inglês

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática em engenharia de dados codificando consultas SQL complexas

Experiência comprovada em SQL – incluindo junções, agregações, funções de janela e ajuste de desempenho

Experiência prática com o PySpark, particularmente com o Spark SQL

Familiaridade com os serviços de dados da AWS (por exemplo, EMR, S3, Glue)

Compreensão de estruturas de modelagem de dados, incluindo a metodologia Kimball

Experiência de trabalho com Snowflake ou data warehouses em nuvem semelhantes

Conhecimento do Apache Iceberg ou formatos de tabela semelhantes (por exemplo, Delta Lake, Hudi)





TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).

  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Requisitos técnicos:


  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Software ou Engenheiro de Software Sênior.

  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e alto tráfego (milhões de transações).
  • Conhecimento sólido em Docker e Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
  • Experiência com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Hub).
  • Domínio de arquitetura orientada a eventos, CQRS e padrões avançados de arquitetura.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e testes de performance (Grafana, Prometheus, K6, Artillery).
  • Atuação com pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab ou similares).
  • Experiência em cloud AWS e/ou Azure (Lambda, Functions, SNS/SQS, CosmosDB, PostgreSQL, entre outros).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para comunicação técnica.



Diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia em projetos do setor tributário, financeiro ou regulado.

title: Supervisor de Registros Técnicos
description:
A CHC do Brasil busca por pessoa Supervisor(a) de Registros Técnicos .


Detalhes da função

O supervisor é responsável pelo departamento de Controle Técnico de Manutenção (Tech Records).

O departamento atualiza bancos de dados dos helicópteros/componentes, faz a verificação de conformidade, e mantém todos os registros detalhados de manutenção dentro dos requisitos da ANAC, do cliente e da empresa.

É diretamente responsável pelos seus subordinados, pela gestão e resultados dos processos em sua área. Conhece e revisa os riscos e o desempenho de seus processos, buscando a melhoria contínua dos processos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Avaliar e atribuir projetos com base nos requisitos comerciais e na competência da equipe;
  • Manter um sistema de controle e armazenamento de registros técnicos, garantindo a conformidade com os padrões da empresa e os requisitos regulamentares;
  • Garantir a precisão e os prazos de todos os registros técnicos e iniciar melhorias contínuas quando forem encontradas discrepâncias, para garantir que não haja recorrência;
  • Fornecer liderança e orientação para a equipe de Registros e Publicações, incluindo treinamento com relação a todos os requisitos regulamentares e procedimentos de registros técnicos;
  • Garantir que as auditorias internas e externas sejam planejadas e executadas;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de melhoria de processos localmente e comunicar-se com o gerente para avaliar o impacto/incorporação na organização global;


Qualificações, Habilidades e Atributos

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, ou áreas correlatadas;
  • Desejável experiência em documentação e registros técnicos de aviação;
  • Inglês Avançado (será testado);
  • Amplo conhecimento de regulamentação nacional;



Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para você juntar um time incrível, em franco crescimento, que mantem os mais altos padrões de qualidade, segurança e excelência em serviços de transporte aéreo.


Vem para o CHC!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic & Video Content Designer

We are building a fast-growing brand in the health and wellness industry and are seeking a strategic, creative, and performance-driven Graphic & Video Content Designer.

This is a key position within the company, with direct impact on sales performance, brand positioning, and overall growth. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, can manage a high volume of projects, and enjoy taking creative ownership, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Create high-impact graphic and video content for paid ads, social media, email marketing, website, and online marketplaces

• Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing strategy and conversion objectives

• Produce short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads, and Amazon

• Prepare and finalize print-ready files for production, ensuring proper bleed, safety margins, color profiles, and print specifications

• Develop technical files for packaging, labels, and promotional materials

• Conduct quality control checks before production

• Maintain brand consistency across all platforms

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines with strong organization and attention to detail

• Hands-on experience preparing print-ready files and packaging materials

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Proven experience with CorelDRAW

• Strong understanding of color profiles, CMYK, RGB, resolution, and print production standards

• Strong portfolio showcasing real projects, preferably performance-driven and e-commerce focused

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

• High level of organization and attention to detail

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred, but portfolio quality and proven experience carry greater weight.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging work environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience

Application Requirements

Mandatory: Please include a portfolio link showcasing both graphic and video projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

In addition, please include your expected monthly compensation for the services to be provided.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.


Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aid training to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.


Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:
The Conversational AI Engineer is the primary agent builder, responsible for developing and deploying intelligent conversational agents using Google Dialogflow CX. This role owns the conversation layer—from NLU model training and dialog flow implementation through webhook fulfillment and multi-channel deployment. Works shoulder-to-shoulder with the Architect on complex features and consumes RAG/LLM components built by the AI/ML Engineer. Performs preliminary technical testing on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA for functional validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement conversational flows, intents, entities, and page/route structures in Dialogflow CX based on user stories and conversation design specifications.
  • Develop webhook fulfillment services in Python or Node.js to handle business logic, API calls, and dynamic responses.
  • Conduct NLU training, testing, and optimization to improve intent recognition accuracy and entity extraction.
  • Integrate generative AI components (built by the AI/ML Engineer) into agent flows—including LLM-powered responses, knowledge retrieval, and summarization features.
  • Deploy and configure agents across channels: web chat, telephony (CCAI), Google Chat, WhatsApp, and custom applications.
  • Design and implement webhook contracts and data schemas between Dialogflow CX agents and n8n workflows (built by the Automation Engineer).
  • Build and maintain n8n workflows for agent fulfillment when scope is straightforward, escalating complex automation to the Automation & Integration Engineer.
  • Implement error handling, fallback strategies, escalation logic, and graceful degradation in agent flows.
  • Perform preliminary technical testing (conversation path testing, webhook validation, intent accuracy checks, regression tests) on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA.
  • Pair-program with the Architect on complex integrations and participate in code reviews.
  • Manage Dialogflow CX versioning, environment promotion, and agent deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning and provide technical estimates for user stories.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, chatbots, or voice agents.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Dialogflow CX (flows, pages, routes, webhooks, test cases).
  • Advanced development skills in Python and/or Node.js with experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Understanding of NLU concepts: intent classification, entity extraction, context management, slot filling.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud services: Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise APIs and SaaS platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Slack).
  • Hands-on experience with n8n (preferred) or comparable automation platforms (Make, Zapier) for building workflows.
  • Proficiency with version control (Git), CI/CD, and agile development practices.
  • Disciplined approach to testing: comfortable writing unit tests, integration tests, and conversation test cases.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder or Vertex AI Search and Conversation.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience deploying agents in multilingual environments.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text and text-to-speech services (Google Cloud Speech APIs).
  • Experience with telephony and contact center integrations.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

title: Técnico de Reparo e Manutenção (Completions)
description:

  • Mantém os equipamentos, instalações e área de trabalho em condições seguras e apresentáveis.
  • Repara máquinas, equipamentos ou estruturas, utilizando ferramentas como martelos, guinchos, guindastes, furadeiras, chaves, ou equipamentos como instrumentos de medição de precisão ou dispositivos de teste elétricos ou eletrônicos.
  • Monta, instala ou repara fiação, componentes elétricos ou eletrônicos, sistemas de tubos, encanamento, maquinário ou equipamentos.
  • Inspeciona peças usadas para determinar alterações nos requisitos dimensionais, usando réguas, calibres, micrômetros ou outros instrumentos de medição.
  • Auxilia, realiza e pode liderar a solução de problemas básicos a complexos, manutenção preventiva programada e modificações em uma ampla gama de equipamentos eletrônicos, mecânicos, pneumáticos ou hidráulicos, incluindo sistemas de aquisição de dados e ferramentas de fundo para determinar a causa da falha, realiza ações corretivas seguindo as políticas e procedimentos documentados da Empresa de acordo com seu nível de treinamento e competência.
  • Auxilia, realiza e pode liderar tarefas de teste e calibração de ferramentas, seguindo políticas e procedimentos documentados de acordo com seu nível de treinamento e competência.
  • Identifica oportunidades de melhoria em relação a equipamentos, procedimentos e documentação.
  • Completa Ordens de Serviço, AIRTs, PFTs, Formulários, Checklists, Solicitações de Reparo e garante que todos os bancos de dados relevantes sejam mantidos com precisão.
  • Cumpre o registro de tempo da WO (Ordens de Serviço) registrando corretamente a entrada/saída do sistema de rastreamento de tempo de WO.
  • Em cargos seniores, o funcionário frequentemente lidera a equipe na realização de todas as atribuições detalhadas acima. Isso inclui a solução de problemas de equipamentos, implementação de ações corretivas e fornecimento de acesso a todas as políticas, procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e manuais técnicos documentados de R&M, permitindo que a equipe de R&M execute seu trabalho de forma eficaz e eficiente.
  • Garanti que todo o pessoal de campo e oficina siga os procedimentos de manutenção corretiva e preventiva, garantindo que todas as falhas sejam acompanhadas até a resolução com uma análise adequada da causa raiz e com a implementação de ações corretivas pré-determinadas.
  • Lidera a oficina e/ou o laboratório eletrônico, definindo e distribuindo os cronogramas de atribuição de trabalho enquanto avaliam a qualidade, competência e eficiência do trabalho realizado, por meio de inspeções regulares para garantir conformidade com os procedimentos operacionais padrão.
  • Solicita peças, suprimentos ou equipamentos de catálogos ou fornecedores aprovados de acordo com as diretrizes e procedimentos da Weatherford.
  • Apoia e cumpre as iniciativas LEAN e participa do programa contínuo de melhoria da eficiência da instalação.
  • Estima os custos de reparo de máquinas, equipamentos ou estruturas prediais.
  • Realizar outras tarefas e atividades com segurança, conforme atribuído pelo supervisor, dentro das limitações físicas do trabalho.


Pré Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em mecânica ou eletrotécnica. CFT ou CREA Ativo.
  • Experiência prévia de no mínimo 4 anos em manutenção de equipamentos de completação Upper Completion (DHSV, VHIF, Miq, MGL, TSR, PDG, etc), lower completion, line hanger e sand control.
  • Desejável conhecimento nos fundamentos da qualidade (FEMEA, 5 Whys, Track and trand, dentre outros).
  • Desejável experiência com inspeção dimensional.
  • Inglês avançado é desejável. Intermediário é mandatório.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce and technology solutions provider delivering innovative, data-driven services to enterprise clients worldwide. We combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help organizations modernize systems, optimize performance, and unlock the value of their data. Our teams partner closely with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, impactful solutions. At Pinnacle Group, we foster collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable results.


Summary

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau who will serve as both a functional and technical partner to the business. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and designing robust Tableau dashboards using advanced calculations and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, business-focused, and capable of building scalable reporting solutions from scratch. This position requires strong stakeholder engagement skills and deep expertise in Tableau development.


Job Description

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and document reporting requirements, define success metrics, and establish actionable KPIs.
  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Tableau dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and advanced LOD expressions.
  • Translate business questions into scalable data models, visualizations, and performance-driven analytics solutions.
  • Create calculated fields, parameters, filters, and data blending solutions to support dynamic reporting needs.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance through efficient data modeling and query tuning.
  • Present findings and insights to business leaders, translating technical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously enhance reporting frameworks by identifying automation opportunities and implementing best practices in BI development.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong Tableau development expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience creating dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and LOD expressions.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into measurable KPIs and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and performance optimization techniques.
  • Ability to balance technical execution with business-facing communication and stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly influence business strategy and decision-making. We empower our employees to take ownership of their work while providing the support and resources needed for professional growth. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Joining our team means contributing to meaningful data-driven transformation while advancing your career in a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.


Instructions

Please answer the questions below, attach your resume and email your responses to the correct contacts as part of your application. Please email your resume and responses to: and .


  • Describe your experience building Tableau dashboards from scratch, including how many you have created, examples of complex calculations, LOD expressions you have implemented.
  • How do you approach gathering business requirements and translating them into measurable KPIs?
  • Please share anything else you would like us to know that highlights your strengths or sets you apart as a Business Intelligence Analyst specialized in Tableau dashboard creation.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

We are seeking a highly skilled GCP DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in containerization, serverless architectures, and leveraging GitLab CI/CD for full lifecycle automation, from infrastructure provisioning to application deployment.


Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Architecture & Development: Design and deploy applications using core GCP services, including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions
  • Data Services: Manage and optimize data persistence and analysis using Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop, manage, and maintain GCP infrastructure using Terraform or Cloud Deployment Manager within a GitOps framework.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build and maintain sophisticated, multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, utilizing GitLab Runners and Docker containers for seamless delivery.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and manage security best practices using Identity and Access Management (IAM) and centralize sensitive information with Secret Manager.
  • Integration & Automation: Securely configure and automate the connection between GitLab CI/CD and GCP resources, specifically by building container images, pushing them to Artifact Registry, and managing deployments via Cloud Deploy or direct service commands.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT Infrastructure related experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • GCP DevOps experience and strong understanding of GCP cloud infrastructure
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture, specifically with GCP, including hands-on experience with GCP services like App Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and Cloud SQL.
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable and secure cloud-based infrastructure for PaaS.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with automation and orchestration tools (e.g., Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Professional certification in Google Cloud Platform is highly preferred (e.g., Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

If you have a strong configuration background and can operate at depth without relying on code, this role is aligned with your profile.

  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
  • Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.


Qualificações



  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.
  • Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário).
  • Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.


Habilidades Necessárias



  • Certificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.).
  • Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE.
  • Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão.
  • Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP.
  • Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken
