title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Gerente de Obras Civis (Experiência em Projetos Industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:


  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built” civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. ✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações

A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Gerente Sênior de Rede de Lojas de Varejo

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.

Foi exatamente por isso que criamos a STOREE.AI.

Isso não é um emprego.


É uma segunda carreira.

title: Analista de Validação de Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Databricks Data Architect
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a Senior Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem with a primary focus on Databricks . This role establishes data architecture standards, drives platform modernization, and partners with business and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high‑quality data solutions. Experience with other modern data platforms is a plus.


Key Responsibilities


Enterprise Architecture & Data Platform Leadership

  • Design and maintain enterprise data architecture across Lakehouse, Warehouse, and streaming environments.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing modern data platforms in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Extensive experience in designing and maintaining Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
  • Lead solution design and best practices for Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture.
  • Define ingestion, integration, and pipeline standards for batch, streaming, and CDC workloads.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to long‑term data platform strategy.


Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development

  • Develop and maintain subject area models, business data models, and dimensional models (fact and dimension tables) and Semantic layer design for BI and AI solutions.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, and business definitions; resolve conflicts in terminology and meaning.
  • Build and maintain enterprise semantic layers to support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
  • Support standardization of facts, dimensions, and shared business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, cost‑optimized, and reliable data architectures in cloud environments.


Data Governance, Quality & Metadata

  • Ensure strong data governance, security, lineage, and compliance across platforms.
  • Perform data quality assessments and identify appropriate data sources in partnership with Business/Data Analysts.
  • Maintain metadata in the enterprise repository and ensure alignment with governance standards.
  • Assist in developing source‑to‑target mappings and validating data transformations.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct user interviews, requirements sessions, and data analysis reviews.
  • Provide architectural oversight and review solution designs across engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts to ensure consistent adoption of architectural standards.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to align data solutions with business needs.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Hands‑on expertise with Databricks; building and maintaining medallion architecture.
  • Strong background in data modeling: dimensional, 3NF, and data vault.
  • Proficiency with Spark, SQL, Python, Kafka, Five Tran, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks.Knowledge of BI/Analytics/AI tools i.e., Power BI, ML Flow, Sage maker, Etc.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, BI, product, and business teams while influencing technical direction.
  • Ability to lead architectural reviews and mentor engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.Ability to influence technical, business, and executive audiences.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.


In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution:

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities:

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests:

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training:

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.


Who You Are:

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.


For this role, you will need:

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.


Our Culture and Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
Hiring: AI Video Editor / Performance Videographer

Company: Rain Media

Reports to: Creative Director

Status: Full-time Contractor (Global)

Location: Argentina and Brazil, preferred


Position Overview

Are You a Performance-Driven Video Editor Who Knows How to Turn Creative Into Conversions? If you think in hooks, pacing, and paid social performance, and you’re already leveraging AI video tools to produce faster, smarter creative, this role is for you.

At Organics Ocean, we’re looking for an AI-native Video Editor / Performance Videographer who will help scale high-volume direct response creative. This role exists to solve a key business need: increasing creative output, improving execution speed, and reducing revision cycles while elevating the quality of edits through advanced AI workflows.

This is a production-first role focused primarily on editing, post-production, and AI-enhanced creative, not traditional filming.

You will work closely with Creative, Growth, and Marketing partners to deliver performance-focused assets that directly impact campaign velocity.


Who we are: Organics Ocean

We are a premium direct-to-consumer supplement brand helping people live healthier lives through science-backed, clean, and effective products.

We’re not a company where things stay the same. We test, we optimize, we innovate—and we want someone who thrives in that kind of high-accountability, fast-paced environment.


Why join our team?


High-growth eCommerce brand: Driven by innovation and fast execution, Organics Ocean has seen 350% year over year growth.


Ownership & Accountability: We trust our team members to take full ownership of their responsibilities. You are empowered to lead, execute, and improve without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative, hold themselves accountable, and drive meaningful results.


A team of high performers: We push boundaries, move fast, and get things done. The company is in a hockey stick growth phase. This is not a good fit for those who don’t want to grow.


Responsibilities

Direct Response Video Editing

  • Produce high-quality paid social performance creatives
  • Execute UGC edits, AI creative, AI UGC, mini-VSL, and VSL formats
  • Optimize pacing, hooks, and CTAs for conversion
  • Deliver high output with minimal revision cycles

AI Video Workflow Integration

  • Use AI tools to accelerate production and improve quality
  • Create both AI-forward and AI-assisted realistic creatives
  • Continuously test new AI workflows to improve performance

Creative Collaboration

  • Partner with Creative Strategy to execute briefs
  • Attend creative meetings to reduce revision loops
  • Align closely with Creative leadership on feedback

Production & Workflow Support

  • Act as a point of contact between Creative Lead and external editors
  • Help disseminate process updates and feedback to contractors
  • Support operational efficiency and creative throughput

Filming (Secondary Responsibility)

  • Occasional product shots or B-roll when needed


What success looks like


First 90 Days

  • Fully ramp into Rain Media’s performance creative workflow and AI editing stack
  • Deliver consistent weekly output aligned to creative briefs and paid social requirements
  • Demonstrate proficiency using required AI tools within real production workflows
  • Reduce revision cycles by actively participating in creative meetings and feedback loops
  • Establish clear collaboration rhythms with Creative leadership and external editors
  • Begin contributing process improvements that increase speed and execution quality

In 12 months:

  • Consistently deliver 15–20 high-performing creatives per week with strong execution speed
  • Become a key leverage point for creative production, supporting communication with external editors and improving workflow efficiency
  • Elevate overall creative quality through advanced AI integration and experimentation
  • Maintain a standard of ≤1 revision cycle between strategy and editing whenever possible
  • Help scale creative volume without sacrificing performance or brand quality
  • Contribute to evolving Rain Media’s AI-first creative production framework


Requirements

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies to Excel in This Role)

  • Ability to communicate (speak/write) fluent English
  • 2 + yrs proven experience editing direct response performance creatives for paid social platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)
  • Must have AI video experience and samples to showcase your work
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused editing, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, and call-to-action structure
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-volume creative output in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment
  • Hands-on experience using AI video generation and enhancement tools within production workflows
  • Proficiency with core editing platforms such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of creative design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma
  • Experience collaborating closely with creative strategists, growth teams, or performance marketing teams
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and execute with minimal revision cycles
  • Strong communication skills and comfort participating in real-time feedback sessions
  • Ability to manage multiple creative experiments simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality

AI & Technical Proficiency (Required)

  • Experience working with tools such as Higgsfield, Google V3/Gemini workflows , or similar AI-driven platforms
  • Understanding of AI-assisted editing techniques, including both overt AI creative and realistic AI integrations

Nice-to-Have Proficiencies

  • Experience with advanced AI platforms such as Sora, Kling , or emerging generative video tools
  • Familiarity with open-source AI workflows or technical experimentation across AI ecosystems
  • Background supporting or coordinating external video editors or creative contractors

Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to work within US time zones (Eastern preferred)
  • Access to a work computer, a reliable internet connection and a distraction-free workspace
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response and AI-enhanced video work


Offer Details

Compensation: Contractor compensation will be aligned to regional market benchmarks based on the candidate’s country of residence and expressed as monthly salary ranges.


About Organics Ocean

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit the website.

The company is a place for innovation. Team roles and responsibilities are clear, and the passion for being a part of something bigger than oneself is shared by everyone. The environment is casual, but the work is serious. Riding this wave of growth only works with A-Players on the team, and that is what everyone is: an A-Player.


Cultural Pillars:

  • Accountability : Take full ownership of your responsibilities and their outcomes. You commit to seeing tasks through, accepting both successes and failures as your own, and continuously learning and improving along the way.
  • Operational Excellence: We believe a strong Foundation is a scalable business. In e-commerce, every action becomes a building block and small cracks compound quickly as we grow. We prioritize building reliable processes, systems, and standards that hold up under scale. We fix breakdowns early, design for consistency, and execute with discipline so growth doesn't introduce chaos.
  • Clarity & Trust: Clarity builds trust, and it goes both ways. Leaders are responsible for setting clear expectations, priorities, and context. Team members are responsible for asking questions, raising their hands, and seeking clarity when something is unclear. When clarity is actively given an actively sought, trust grows, decisions improve, and the teams move faster together.
  • Efficient Leverage: Efficient leverage means doing the right work, not more work. We challenge the status quo, explore better ways of working, and speak up when we see opportunities to improve. We value fresh thinking, but apply it with intention, building systems, making decisions, and creating leverage that drives meaningful impact. Through innovation paired with discipline, we pull the right levers to move the business forward and scale sustainably.
  • Move Fast and Persevere: We push forward with speed and determination, even when things get tough. In the fast-paced world of e-commerce and startups, challenges are inevitable. Success comes from acting quickly, adapting, and staying resilient when obstacles arise. We don’t slow down when things get hard—we press through and keep moving forward.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking


Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.


In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.


Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.


Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

* Strong understanding of structural mechanics, load calculations, and material properties.

* Tech-savvy: comfortable with CAD tools, Excel for calculations, and modern productivity software. Experience using AI tools to increase efficiency is a plus.

* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and communication skills.

* Self-motivated and able to manage project timelines independently in a remote setting.


What We Offer:

* 100% remote, home-office flexibility.

* Flexible hours/project-based engagement to start, with potential to develop into a full-time position.

* Exposure to international projects and clients.

* Growth opportunities within a scaling global network.


How to Apply: Please complete our initial screening form here:


Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas SAP MM Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Prestar suporte Nível 2 aos utilizadores do módulo SAP MM (Materials Management), incluindo processos de compras (Procure to Pay), gestão de stocks, MRP (Material Requirements Planning), GNF (Gestão Não Financeira) para contratos de compra e serviços, e gestão de dados mestre de fornecedores e materiais (Cadastro BP).
  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes e problemas funcionais relacionados com os processos de compras, gestão de inventário, avaliação de materiais, e dados mestre.
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz para problemas nos processos de requisição de compra, cotação, pedido de compra, entrada de mercadorias (MIGO), entrada de faturas (MIRO), gestão de stocks e inventário físico.
  • Efetuar configurações e ajustes no módulo SAP MM para atender às necessidades do negócio e corrigir falhas, seguindo as melhores práticas e a governança de TI.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para melhorias ou correções que necessitem de desenvolvimento ABAP, colaborando com a equipa de Nível 3.
  • Participar ativamente nos testes funcionais e integrados de novas configurações, desenvolvimentos e melhorias no SAP MM.
  • Orientar e apoiar Key Users e analistas de Nível 1, partilhando conhecimento e auxiliando na resolução de dúvidas sobre os processos de MM.
  • Manter a documentação dos processos, configurações e soluções atualizada na
  • ferramenta Jira e na base de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com as equipas de projeto em iniciativas de evolução do SAP S/4HANA e sistemas satélites relacionados com o módulo MM.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos SLAs para atendimento e solução de chamados.


Requisitos:

  • Profundo conhecimento dos processos de negócio de Compras (Procure-to-Pay), Gestão de Stocks e Recebimento Físico/Fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em configuração e parametrização do SAP MM (ex: estruturas organizacionais de compras, tipos de documento de compras, determinação de preços em compras, avaliação de materiais, gestão de lotes, números de série).
  • Conhecimento em processos de MRP e gestão de necessidades de materiais.
  • Familiaridade com a gestão de dados mestre de materiais e fornecedores (Business Partner).
  • Conhecimento da integração do SAP MM com outros módulos SAP (ex: FI, CO, SD, PP, QM).
  • Conhecimento em Jira para gestão de chamados.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Java para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços, trabalhando de forma próxima aos times internos e aos clientes. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo no entendimento de requisitos, na construção de soluções técnicas, em integrações entre sistemas e em iniciativas de melhoria contínua, sempre com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e boas práticas de engenharia de software.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Analisar e compreender necessidades de negócio e requisitos técnicos, colaborando com equipes internas e stakeholders para desenhar soluções adequadas e sustentáveis;
  • Desenvolver e manter código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões, boas práticas e princípios de arquitetura moderna;
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção e planejamento até implementação, testes e implantação em produção;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microsserviços, integrações e APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente entre sistemas;
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e lideranças técnicas, compartilhando conhecimento e contribuindo para a evolução do time;
  • Participar de revisões de código, cerimônias ágeis e discussões técnicas, apoiando a melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Comunicar-se de forma clara e objetiva com o time e stakeholders, acompanhando progresso, riscos e soluções;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e boas práticas do mercado, aplicando esse conhecimento na evolução das soluções.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando Java, atuando na construção, evolução e sustentação de soluções em produção;
  • Vivência consistente com Spring Boot, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura, organização de código e desacoplamento;
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços, lidando com comunicação entre serviços, versionamento, resiliência e escalabilidade;
  • Atuação com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou Redis, compreendendo modelagem, performance e estratégias de persistência;
  • Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, com atuação em AWS, GCP ou Azure, apoiando deploy, escalabilidade e operação das aplicações;
  • Vivência com conteinerização e orquestração, utilizando Docker ou Kubernetes, tanto em desenvolvimento quanto em produção;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful, garantindo integração eficiente, segura e bem documentada entre sistemas;
  • Conhecimento e prática em observabilidade, utilizando ferramentas como DataDog, New Relic, Grafana ou Prometheus para monitorar, diagnosticar e evoluir aplicações em produção.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento em Python, especialmente para automações, integrações, jobs ou apoio a pipelines e serviços.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;

  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;

  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns


What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About VEL

Civilization is shifting.

AI is no longer confined to the browser. Work is decentralizing. Cities are restructuring. Corporate real estate is contracting.

VEL is building Physical AI infrastructure — intelligent, distributed environments embedded into airports, commercial buildings, and urban nodes.

VEGA is what people experience. IRIS is the intelligence layer that governs it.

We are not building chat interfaces.

We are building embodied AI systems operating in real-world environments.


The Role

The Chief of Staff is the CEO’s strategic execution partner — responsible for converting executive intent into structured, measurable execution across the company.


You will operate across:

● Product (Physical AI systems)

● Fundraise and capital coordination

● Manufacturing partners

● Real estate and deployment strategy

● International expansion

● Board and investor communications


This is not an administrative role.

This is not calendar management.

This is a cross-functional force multiplier role embedded in high-velocity decision environments.


You will:

● Translate CEO strategy into executable workstreams

● Drive OKR cadence and operational rhythm

● Prepare board materials and investor updates

● Support capital raise execution and investor coordination

● Maintain discipline across execution systems (Monday.com, Miro, etc.)

● Identify risk early and enforce accountability

● Coordinate cross-border stakeholders

This role requires executive maturity, commercial literacy, and comfort operating in ambiguity.


Mandatory Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

● Minimum 3 years serving as Chief of Staff reporting directly to a CEO

● Experience in a venture-backed or high-growth environment

● Direct exposure to capital raise cycles

● Ownership of board-level documentation and reporting

● Financial literacy (runway, unit economics, forecasting inputs)

● Experience implementing structured execution systems

● Strong English communication

● Willingness to travel extensively

You Are Likely Coming From

● A venture-backed startup in growth stage

● An infrastructure, hardware, or deep-tech environment

● A company operating across multiple countries

● A high-velocity environment with capital exposure


You understand that:

● Execution discipline determines survival

● Capital alignment drives strategy

● Ambiguity is normal at scale-building companies

● Board-level communication must be precise

● Travel is part of building global infrastructure

You prefer ownership over supervision.

You are comfortable operating without detailed instructions.


Who Should Not Apply

● Executive Assistants repositioning as Chief of Staff

● Strategy consultants without operating accountability

● Candidates without capital exposure

● Individuals unwilling to travel 90–120 days per year

● Candidates seeking low-intensity environments

What We Offer

● Direct CEO exposure

● Global operational footprint

● Board-level experience

● Infrastructure-scale problem set

● Equity upside

● Responsibility for execution coherence across the company

We are building infrastructure for the next era of work.


Travel Requirement: 90–120 days per year (US, Europe, GCC)

This role requires regular international travel for investor engagement, manufacturing coordination, and deployment oversight. Candidates must be fully comfortable operating in a travel-intensive environment.


Compensation: $60,000–$85,000 USD + meaningful equity

Compensation will be aligned to experience, depth of operating exposure, and prior executive-level responsibility. Equity participation reflects the strategic importance of this role.


Reporting Line: Reports directly to the CEO

This is a senior strategic position with cross-functional authority across product, capital, manufacturing, and deployment.


Role Type: Full-time, long-term strategic hire

This is not a contract position. We are building foundational infrastructure and expect long-term ownership and accountability.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions
